observations.observed: The preview surface rendered the reconcile ledger root on first load.
observations.bearsOnClaim: The reconcile CLI turns four differently shaped exports into one ledger.

observations.observed: Two of the four fixture exports produced unmatched lines that the ledger itemised rather than silently dropping.
observations.bearsOnClaim: A wrongly matched line is costlier than an unmatched one.

claimsWithNoObservation.claim: The bookkeeper saves a morning every Monday.
claimsWithNoObservation.why: No user was observed. The StoryPack already carried this as unbound; nothing in LEARN changed that.

claimed: Every observation names its source and the claim it bears on.
Claims with no observation behind them are listed rather than dropped.
notRun: No audience observation of any kind; this wave has no users.
No post-launch telemetry, because nothing was launched beyond a local preview.

refused.item: Reporting a success-condition verdict for the fifteen-minute target
refused.reason: The success condition is about a real bookkeeper's Monday. Nothing here observed one, so any verdict would be a conclusion with an empty subject.
